task.title: Sign in to your account with your 2FA recovery codes
task.shortdesc: Use a recovery code to log in to your Red Hat account if your authentication device is not available.

ul.li: Ensure you have a registered Red Hat user account with two-factor authentication enabled.
Ensure you have access to your recovery codes.

step.cmd: Use your browser to navigate to a Red Hat site, such as Red Hat Customer Portal.
Log in using your Red Hat login.
Enter your Red Hat password. A page opens to verify two-factor authentication and asks for a one-time code.

info.p: You are prompted to choose recovery codes.

step.cmd: Enter the recovery code from your list and click Log in.
